report/study3/data/raw/runs_drake_acquis.rows: one per simulated run: hand x friction x cylinder radius x placement x load direction (or trajectory)

report/study3/data/raw/runs_drake_coin.c.rows: one per simulated run: hand x friction x cylinder radius x placement x load direction (or trajectory)

protocol.grasp: the cylinder is placed where O's proximal and distal pads both touch it at flexion q0 and the finger is closed to O's joint setpoint q0 + 5 deg at stiffness K0 (joint impedance control); the same setpoint is given to every hand unless the setting says otherwise
protocol.gate0: the grasp is accepted when both pads hold the cylinder still after release (gate0_pass)
protocol.pull-out: a load in one direction (+x toward the fingertip, -x toward the palm, -z out of the grasp, +x-z diagonal) rises until the grasp gives way; measure = that load
protocol.grasp acquisition: from the open finger, closing to O's setpoint draws the cylinder in against a load; measure = distance drawn in
protocol.dial: one closing turns a sprung dial pressed between both pads; measure = rotation (experiments 24, 26; superseded)
protocol.fingertip dial: the distal pad alone drives a dial against a torsional spring as the finger sweeps open-loop from O's touch angle; z: a disk whose top face the pad drags, y: a rim pushed tangentially; the proximal pad never touches; measure = rotation (experiment 28)
protocol.fingertip coin drag: the distal pad alone drags a 2 mm coin (tethered at 45 N/m, coin-table mu 0.2) toward the MCP on a table sprung at 30 N/m, sweeping 45-55 deg open-loop from O's touch angle; measure = the coin's travel at the end (experiment 30b; time step 0.25 ms)
protocol.in-hand rolling: after the grasp, an open-loop flexion sweep of 8 or 15 deg rolls the cylinder; measure = rotation

events.slip: a pad's tangential speed exceeds 10 mm/s
events.loss: a pad's normal force falls below the threshold (the pad leaves the cylinder)
events.collapse: the finger is pushed open (the joint yields) before the pads slip
events.roll: the cylinder rolls past the threshold

error.D: effect of the friction change in a run pair: measure(mu 2.0) - measure(mu 1.3) at the same placement, direction and radius
error.E (per pair): |D(hand) - D(O)| / |D(O)|, over the pairs where O and the hand both pass gate 0 at both frictions and the measure exists
error.E (per hand, errors_by_hand.csv): median over that hand's pairs (sim/drake/analyze.py error()); tasks drop pairs with a small effect on O (|D(O)| < 0.3 mm or deg, rolling < 0.5 deg); acquisition scores a hand that loses the cylinder as the largest error
error.experiment 25: each redesigned hand is compared with O carrying the same soft pad (tags e25-ref5/7/9)

hands.R: 7 mm redesign keeping the contact-surface motion (Δ_contact 0.86 mm)
hands.U: 7 mm redesign for coverage only (Δ_contact 3.91 mm)
hands.naming: dN (p = decimal point): target Δ_contact in mm; h3toN: 3 -> N mm; maxDs/minDs: largest or smallest skeleton change for that target; _hr/_hu: the R- and U-type designs at another thickness; _s0/_s1: search seed
